decisions.reason: The modular plant concept matches the firm's announced push toward modular, cleaner solutions, and the firm has publicly claimed savings of more than 600,000 euros per year, so its commitment is high and the evidence is positive.
The slow-speed shredder sits close to the core offer and has its own dedicated web page, signalling a visible investment and commitment the firm will want to justify and sustain.

As a multi-model modular product line it carries substantial sunk development costs and is central to the firm's strategic direction, so any early weakness would likely be read as temporary market ramp-up.
The trommel screen is a natural extension of the established mobile machinery range and complements the shredders, and with the firm growing and no negative signals there is no reason to withdraw it.
